task: Token refresh: `POST /api/v1/auth/refresh` with the JSON body `{"refreshToken": <the refresh_token returned by login>}` answers HTTP 200 with a non-empty `access_token` string, and that new access token authenticates `GET /api/v1/auth/me` (HTTP 200).

Registration validation: `POST /api/v1/auth/register` with a syntactically invalid e-mail address (for example `not-an-email`) and an otherwise valid username and password is refused with HTTP 400, and no account is created (logging in with that e-mail and password is also refused).

Updating a knowledge base: for a signed-in user's knowledge base, `PUT /api/v1/knowledge-bases/{id}` with a new `name` and a new `description` answers HTTP 200 with `data.name` and `data.description` equal to the new values, and `GET /api/v1/knowledge-bases/{id}` then returns the same new values.

Deleting a knowledge base: `DELETE /api/v1/knowledge-bases/{id}` of a signed-in user's own knowledge base answers HTTP 200 with `success` true, after which `GET /api/v1/knowledge-bases/{id}` answers HTTP 404 and the knowledge base no longer appears in `GET /api/v1/knowledge-bases`.

Knowledge base tags: after a signed-in user creates three tags with distinct names in one of their knowledge bases (`POST /api/v1/knowledge-bases/{id}/tags` with `{"name": ...}`), `GET /api/v1/knowledge-bases/{id}/tags` answers HTTP 200 with `data.total` equal to 3 and `data.data` listing the three tag names.
